# Contributing to QBSmarter

This GitHub repository is a **read-only mirror** of the canonical project at
[codeberg.org/zucham/QBSmarter](https://codeberg.org/zucham/QBSmarter).

The maintainer does not monitor issues, pull requests, or discussions on the
GitHub mirror. To contribute:

- **Bug reports and feature requests**: open an issue on the
  [Codeberg issue tracker](https://codeberg.org/zucham/QBSmarter/issues),
  or email `zucham@duck.com` with a subject line containing `QBSmarter`.
- **Code changes and translations**: fork the project on Codeberg, push your
  branch there, and open a pull request against `main`.
- **Full contribution guide**:
  [CONTRIBUTING.md on Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/zucham/QBSmarter/src/branch/main/assets/Markdown/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Sorry for the friction. Keeping the project's source of truth on a single
forge means everyone reads from the same canonical history.
